text:
ana: quick sync: finalizing the OSS reference app launch checklist + webinar + benchmark narrative. Draft doc: https://tiny.redwood/refapp-launch (private)

matt: agree we should surface dev-focused metrics: end-to-end latency, cost/1M tokens, and a small real-workload example (chatty multi-turn).

jay: will add three reproducible configs: local-dev (cpu), staging (single GPU), prod (dedicated). I'll include the exact run command and sample CSV of requests.

remi: webinar ops: plan = 8m intro, 22m demo (deep dive into code + deploy), 15m benchmark walkthrough, 15m q&a. CTA = GitHub repo + starter template signup.

marie: routing: require utm_source=refapp, utm_campaign=launch; hidden form captures email+org. Tag as "refapp-launch" in HubSpot and add to nurture drip. Can ops expose a minimal landing endpoint?

ops-bot: infra note: demo instance provisioning scheduled (job demo-20260618-7). ETA 3h.

matt: A/B test two headlines on the blog modal: "Ship LLM features fast" vs "Make inference predictable & cheap". small sample split.

jay: bench snippet I'll add to the repo README. example:
```bash
python bench.py --model redwood-3b --seq 512 --batch 4 --requests sample_requests.csv
```

remi: I can own slides + dry-run scheduling. request a 30m tech rehearsal 48h before event.

ana: I'll present and draft the blog post. I'll take the matt headline options and the checklist: TL;DR + how-to + bench + GH link + webinar CTA.

marie: lead nurture plan: immediate welcome email (starter kit), 24h bench highlights, 7d case study + trial invite. escalate to AE if engagement threshold met. I'll export HubSpot workflow JSON and drop in the doc.

ana: action items summarized in the doc. I'll ping when the blog draft is ready for quick review. :+1:
